subject: Post-call recap + pick a 30-min window for a first-look walkthrough
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Chen <sophie@helioworks.com>, Luis Martinez <luis@helioworks.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jul 2024 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + pick a 30-min window for a first-look walkthrough

Hi Sophie (and Luis),

Thanks again for the time this morning — really helpful to hear how HelioWorks is thinking about inference at scale. Quick recap from our side so we have alignment before we lock a short walkthrough: 

- Primary goals: predictable latency for customer-facing features, tighter unit cost controls on heavy-traffic endpoints, and a path for a private deployment (VPC/on-prem) for regulated clients.
- Key constraints: procurement window targets Q4, security review required (SOC2 evidence + network isolation), and engineering availability limited on the weeks of 7/29 and 8/5.

Next step: a focused 30-minute first-look walkthrough (product + infra fit). Can you pick one of these slots? All times are PT — I included an ET equivalent in parentheses for convenience. If none of these work, propose two that do and we’ll adapt.

Option A — Tue Jul 23, 09:00–09:30 PT (12:00–12:30 ET)
Option B — Wed Jul 24, 11:00–11:30 PT (14:00–14:30 ET)
Option C — Thu Jul 25, 15:00–15:30 PT (18:00–18:30 ET)

Helpful requests for the session: please include your engineering lead and the person who would run security/compliance for this evaluation (so we can cover architecture and audit expectations). I’ll send a short agenda and a 1-page pre-read in advance — attached here is a living pre-read stub and a proposed agenda (will update once slot is confirmed).

Calendar link to book directly: https://cal.redwood.com/neha/30
Attachments: HelioWorks-PreRead-Notes.pdf (summary) | Redwood-30min-Agenda.md

Thanks — Neha

--
Neha Kapoor
